response.reason: The three generic structures each test a single metric (clearances or saves) against a similar-opponent cohort with no conditions. C9 is structurally distinct in two ways: (1) it tests clearances and saves jointly as a combined defensive workload signal — the mechanism requires both to move together, which is a different statistical question from either metric alone; (2) the similar-opponent cohort is explicitly conditioned on an opponent_profile axis (HIGH attacking output: shots, shots on target, final third entries), whereas all three generics carry no conditions at all. The cross-window trend evidence (long-run → W10 → W5) is motivational context, not the core contrast, so the candidate is not reducible to a recent-vs-long-run comparison. The incremental structure is real and not merely a rewording.
